skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.cobblesto: break stone with any pickaxe, even a wooden one.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.skill_cos: coal ore, common in mountains and cave walls (y 0 to 190). The ore or the coal both count. Needs Mining: Stone.
copper ore, in caves between y -16 and 112 (lots in dripstone caves). The ore or raw copper both count.
iron ore, in caves between y -24 and 56 and high in mountains. The ore or raw iron both count.
gold ore, below y 32 (plenty in badlands). The ore or raw gold both count.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.cobalt_he: defeat the Cobalt Golem. Altar in the Cobalt Shrine (standing stones in plains, forests, taigas and savannas) or in the back room of the disused mine in the mountains. Offering: 4 iron blocks.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.raw_cobal: cobalt ore, in the Overworld below y 32 (rich veins below y 0). Iron pickaxe or better.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.diamond: diamond ore, below y 16 (best near y -59). Needs a cobalt pickaxe.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.abyssal_c: defeat the Abyssal Guardian in the Abyssal Sanctum, in the Deep Dark between y -40 and -16. Offering: 4 echo shards (ancient city chests).
skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.netherite: smelt ancient debris, in the Nether between y 8 and 22. Diamond pickaxe.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.colossus_: defeat the Igneous Colossus, asleep on the throne of the Colossus Forge in the Nether's Infernite Peaks (basalt plateaus). It wakes when someone comes within 16 blocks.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.raw_infer: infernite ore, Nether only; exposed and in rich veins in the Infernite Peaks. Netherite pickaxe.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.dragon_sc: defeat the Ender Dragon on the End's main island. The scales drop on the exit portal.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.raw_endit: endite ore, everywhere in the End. Infernite pickaxe.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.astral_fr: defeat the Astral Herald at the vault altar on top of the End Citadel (outer islands; ride the purpur elevators up). Offering: 4 Sentinel Cores, dropped by Purpur Sentinels.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.raw_astra: astralite ore, only on the End's outer islands (over 1000 blocks from the center). Endite pickaxe.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.nether_st: defeat the Wither: 3 wither skeleton skulls (Nether fortresses) on 4 soul sand or soul soil blocks in a T.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.copper_in: smelt raw copper in a furnace.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.iron_ingo: smelt raw iron in a furnace.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.cobalt_in: smelt raw cobalt in a furnace.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.netherite: 4 netherite scrap + 4 gold ingots on a crafting table.

item.mlinnotas.quest_book.tooltip: Right-click or press Y: world goals and rewards
gui.mlinnotas.quests.title: Quest Book
quest.mlinnotas.basics.welcome.desc: This book guides you through the mod. Progress belongs to the world: what one of you does counts for both, but each player claims their own reward. Open it with L or the book. Check this quest to begin.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.wood.desc: An axe on a log with leaves fells the whole tree (sneak to break a single block). Gather 16 logs.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.stone_tools.desc: Craft a stone pickaxe. Note: ores only break with the right Mining level in the skill tree (K key). See the Mining chapter.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.wand.desc: Click a face with the wand to extend it using blocks from your inventory: wood places 9 at once, and each tier places more (up to 1024 with celestium).
quest.mlinnotas.basics.harvest.desc: Right-click a ripe crop to harvest and replant it. With a hoe you harvest an area: copper/iron 3x3, gold to diamond 5x5, netherite and up 7x7.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.crafting_tablet.d: The Crafting Tablet is a portable 3x3 grid: right-click it, or press C with it anywhere in your inventory.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.backpack.desc: 27 extra slots: open it with right-click or the V key. Size, crafting, furnace and tank upgrades are in the Technology chapter.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.hud.desc: O sorts your inventory (Shift+O sorts yours in a chest screen; Ord button on chests). N shows what you are looking at: whether your tool harvests it and what is inside chests. G toggles bright vision. Check when you've tried them.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.minimap.desc: In the corner: H toggles it, - and = change size, [ and ] zoom, J cave mode. M opens the big map (drag, zoom, right-click adds a waypoint). B marks a waypoint where you stand.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.recipes.desc: With an inventory screen open, the item list appears on the right: R shows recipes and U shows uses of the item under the cursor. Search @mod to filter by mod.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.sleep.desc: Only half of the players need to sleep for the night to pass: in a pair, one in bed is enough. The action bar shows how many are missing.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_stone.desc: Open the skill tree (K) and deposit 32 cobblestone into Mining: Stone. Without it not even coal breaks. The tree belongs to the world: anyone can deposit.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_copper.desc: Costs 10 coal (the ore or the dropped coal). Unlocks copper ore and the first level of the side branches.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.side_branch.desc: Combat, Vigor, Agility and Prospecting have 5 levels each, paid with ingots and XP, and apply to every player. Start with Combat I (16 copper ingots + 5 levels).
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_iron.desc: Costs 10 raw copper (or ore) + 3 XP levels. Unlocks iron and lapis.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.iron_gear.desc: An iron pickaxe. Iron also makes the iron furnace upgrade, bigger chests and the 4 iron blocks offered to the Cobalt Golem.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_gold.desc: Costs 10 raw iron + 5 levels. Gold is now a real tier between iron and cobalt. Unlocks gold and redstone.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_cobalt.desc: Needs the Cobalt Heart dropped by the Cobalt Golem (Bosses chapter), + 10 raw gold + 10 levels.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.cobalt.desc: Blue Overworld ore in stone and deepslate below y=32 (rich veins deep down). Needs an iron pickaxe. Smelt it: the waystone recipe uses an ingot.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_diamond.des: Costs 10 raw cobalt + 15 levels. Diamond now needs a cobalt pickaxe.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_netherite.d: Needs the Abyssal Core (Abyssal Guardian) + 5 diamonds + 20 levels. Unlocks ancient debris.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_infernite.d: Needs the Colossus Ember (Igneous Colossus) + 4 netherite scrap + 20 levels. Infernite only exists in the Nether and needs a netherite pickaxe.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_endite.desc: Needs a Dragon Scale (Ender Dragon) + 10 raw infernite + 25 levels. Endite appears all over the End (infernite pickaxe).
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_astralite.d: Needs the Astral Fragment (Astral Herald) + 10 raw endite + 30 levels. Astralite only appears on the outer End islands (endite pickaxe).
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_celestium.d: Needs a Nether Star (Wither) + 10 raw astralite + 40 levels. Unlocks the celestium alloy.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.celestium.desc: Shapeless alloy: 2 astralite + 2 endite + 2 infernite + 1 netherite. The top of the ladder: 20 armor, a 1024-block wand, a 243-slot chest.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.explore.desc: Small ruins dot the Overworld, about one every 380 blocks. Each kind prefers certain biomes and hides a chest. Mark a home waypoint (B) before leaving.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.watchtower.d: Plains, savannas and hills. Climb the spiral stairs to the deck: the chest is up there, and a waystone stands in the little square nearby.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.camp.desc: Forests and taigas. Striped wool tents, a dead campfire and a chest in the big tent.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.well.desc: Dry biomes (desert, savanna, badlands). Climb down the ladder into the cistern: the chest is down there by the water.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.chapel.desc: Dark forest and swamp. A collapsed nave, broken stained glass, a fallen bell and an altar with a lectern. A waystone stands nearby.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.mine.desc: Mountains. Follow the railed ramp to the hall with a copper or iron vein; an old altar room waits at the bottom.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.all_ruins.de: All five ruins visited. This quest completes by itself.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.waystone.des: Right-click a waystone to activate it for the whole world and open the destination list. Travel costs 1 level per 500 blocks (3 across dimensions). A name tag renames it.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.waystone_cra: Recipe: polished stone + ender pearl + cobalt ingot. Put one at your base. The Return Scroll takes you to the last waystone used.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.biomes.desc: Visit a jungle, a desert, a swamp and a snowy biome. Monsters there may spawn as variants: Mossy Zombie, Blazing Skeleton, Snow Spider, Mangrove Drowned.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.deep_dark.de: Deep below the mountains. Sneak: sculk calls the Warden. Ancient cities hold echo shards, and the Abyssal Sanctum lies here too.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.cobalt_shrine.des: Plains, forests, taigas and savannas: 8 standing stones with cobalt veins around a stepped dais, with the altar in the middle.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.iron_blocks.desc: The cobalt altar asks for 4 iron blocks: right-click it with them in your inventory. Boss health is tuned for 2 players.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.cobalt_golem.desc: Heavy punches, a ground slam in a 6-block ring and thrown rocks; below half health it charges. Drops the Cobalt Heart (Mining: Cobalt).
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.abyssal_sanctum.d: In the Deep Dark, between y -40 and -16: a deepslate hall with pillars, sculk and a staircase. The abyssal altar sits in the center.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.echo_shards.desc: They come from ancient city chests, also in the Deep Dark. The abyssal altar asks for 4.
A sonic pulse that ignores armor, and darkness; in phase 2 sculk tentacles grab you. Drops the Abyssal Core (Mining: Netherite).
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.colossus_forge.de: In the Nether's Infernite Peaks: a blackstone arena with a lava ring and basalt pillars. The colossus sleeps on its throne and wakes when a survival player comes within 16 blocks.
A ring of fire and a magma meteor shower; in phase 2 it opens lava pools announced by particles. Bring fire resistance. Drops the Colossus Ember (Mining: Infernite).
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.ender_dragon.desc: Phase 1: void meteors and mites. Phase 2: two crystals respawn, dives and sentinels. Phase 3: breath barrages. Every kill leaves Dragon Scales and a treasure chest on the north dais.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.sentinel_cores.de: The Citadel's Purpur Sentinels drop cores. The astral altar in the top vault asks for 4.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.astral_herald.des: It flies, fires homing star bolts and teleports; in phase 2 it summons sentinels. Drops the Astral Fragment (Mining: Astralite).
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.wither.desc: 3 wither skeleton skulls on 4 soul sand in a T. Fight far from home! Drops the Nether Star (Mining: Celestium and the beacon).
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.legends.desc: Every boss defeated. This quest completes by itself.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.enter_nether.desc: An obsidian portal (water over lava in a mold makes obsidian without a diamond pickaxe). The Nether is rebuilt for walking: continuous ground, lava only at valley floors, a high ceiling.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.ashen_plains.desc: Low dunes of ash and soul soil under falling ash. Beware the Ashen Wither Skeleton, which blinds.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.burning_grove.des: Giant low-capped fungi, vines and ember nylium. Magma Slugs crawl around here.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.magma_slug.desc: Slow, but they burn. They drop magma cream, handy for fire resistance potions.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.infernite_peaks.d: Basalt and blackstone plateaus with exposed infernite. The Colossus Forge is here (Bosses chapter).
quest.mlinnotas.nether.infernite.desc: A Nether-only ore with rich veins in the Peaks. Needs a netherite pickaxe and Mining: Infernite.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.fortress.desc: Fortresses now sit on the ground. Blazes and wither skeletons live there.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.blaze_rods.desc: They become blaze powder for Eyes of Ender (the way to the End) and the brewing stand.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.wither_skulls.des: Wither skeletons sometimes drop their skull (Looting helps). Three skulls summon the Wither.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.bastion.desc: Piglin ruins full of gold and brutes. Wear a piece of gold armor so regular piglins don't attack.
quest.mlinnotas.end.eyes.desc: Blaze powder + ender pearl. Throw an eye and follow it to the stronghold.
quest.mlinnotas.end.stronghold.desc: The End portal lies in a room with lava and silverfish. Fill it with the eyes.
quest.mlinnotas.end.enter_end.desc: The central island is now a ruined sanctuary with a purpur colonnade and walls. The Dragon awaits (Bosses chapter).
quest.mlinnotas.end.outer_islands.desc: After the dragon an end gateway appears: throw a pearl into it. Past 1000 blocks from the center the mod's large biomes begin.
quest.mlinnotas.end.moss_fields.desc: Moss, void grass, void trees, lilies and shallow ponds. Full of Void Jellies.
quest.mlinnotas.end.void_jelly.desc: Floating translucent bells. Eating Void Jelly gives slow falling.
quest.mlinnotas.end.crystal_grove.desc: Giant crystal spikes and open calcite geodes of ether crystal.
quest.mlinnotas.end.crystal_mite.desc: Six-legged crabs covered in crystal: their bite causes glowing and slowness.
quest.mlinnotas.end.void_wastes.desc: At the edge of regions: ash, craters, void basalt pillars and giant fossils.
quest.mlinnotas.end.chorus_forest.desc: Dense giant chorus, chorus flowers and End mushrooms. Chorus Hoppers bounce around and teleport when hit.
quest.mlinnotas.end.chorus_hopper.desc: Passive creatures that drop chorus fruit.
quest.mlinnotas.end.citadel.desc: Replaces the End City: its own island, a 5-floor central keep and towers joined by bridges. Shulkers guard the roofs and Purpur Sentinels patrol.
quest.mlinnotas.end.elevator.desc: Jump on it to go up and sneak to go down to the next elevator in the column (up to 32 blocks). Craft your own with sentinel cores.
quest.mlinnotas.end.elytra.desc: The vault atop the keep holds the elytra, a dragon head and the astral altar.
quest.mlinnotas.task.stone_chest: Have a Stone Chest or its upgrade
quest.mlinnotas.task.iron_chest: Have an Iron Chest or its upgrade
quest.mlinnotas.task.diamond_chest: Have a Diamond Chest or its upgrade
quest.mlinnotas.tech.furnace_stone.desc: Right-click a furnace with the upgrade. Stone makes it 1.25x faster; each tier uses the previous one in the middle of the recipe, up to celestium (32x).
quest.mlinnotas.tech.furnace_iron.desc: The iron upgrade uses the copper one in the middle. The tier shows on the HUD (N) when you look at the furnace.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.furnace_endite.desc: From the endite upgrade on, the furnace gives 2 ingots per raw ore or ore block.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.stone_chest.desc: One chest per tier: stone 36, iron 54, gold 81, diamond 108, up to celestium 243. A chest upgrade converts a placed chest (right-click), keeping contents and name.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.iron_chest.desc: 54 slots. The screen scrolls with the mouse wheel past 6 rows, and the Ord button sorts the whole chest.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.diamond_chest.desc: 108 slots: plenty of room for the pair's base.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.backpack_size.desc: +27 slots per upgrade, up to 81. Pick up the upgrade, hover it over the backpack in your inventory and right-click.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.backpack_tools.desc: The furnace upgrade smelts the contents using fuel from the backpack; crafting adds a 3x3 grid to its screen; water and lava tanks fill with Shift+click on a source.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.enchanting.desc: The table no longer rolls dice: pick the enchantment and level. Costs XP and 1 lapis per level; 15 bookshelves unlock the max. You can upgrade an enchantment paying only the difference.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.beacon.desc: The weakest metal in the pyramid sets the tier: iron reaches 50, cobalt 70, netherite 100, up to celestium 200. Infernite and up unlock level III and Prospecting; celestium unlocks Flight within range.

message.mlinnotas.dungeon.gate_locked: The gate is sealed. Defeat the dungeon's guardian to get the key.
message.mlinnotas.dungeon.gate_opened: The key turns and the gate opens
message.mlinnotas.dungeon.boss_defeated: %s has fallen! It dropped %s Dungeon Key(s): one for each of you to open the vault.
